purpose: A versioned empirical coverage matrix for research toward broad generalization; not a claim that AGI or superintelligence has been achieved.
global_rules: Repository-level engineering tests are not evidence of broad general intelligence.
Internal fixtures are not independent benchmarks; missing external evidence blocks promotion.
Every accepted campaign must bind exact runtime, evaluator, corpus, oracle, configuration, run nonce, outcomes, and timestamped signed receipt.
Negative results and source-domain regressions must be retained; successful promotion requires fresh independent holdout retesting.
No aggregate superintelligence score or AGI/SI label is defined by this matrix.

Every track must distinguish implementation status, repository-CI status, deployment verification, and independent external evaluation. Internal CI does not count as deployment or independent verification.

signals.measured_gap: Google's Co-Scientist paper (Nature, 2026-05-19) describes a multi-agent system that generates, critiques and refines hypotheses for experimental verification. MechHypoBench (2026-10-04) combines mechanisms from 14 fields with 17.98 million observations and evaluates hypotheses by consequences under withheld conditions; its authors report a substantial gap between generated hypotheses and underlying mechanisms. AUREN has no expert-scored hypothesis benchmark, intervention result, or independent replication receipt. TruthInsightBench's reported agents show a gap between traceable/novel claims and robust, controlled, cross-dataset conclusions. MechHypoBench tests consequences under withheld conditions. AUREN has no independent scientific replication receipt. DeepMind's 2026-11-03 cheminformatics workflow is a useful end-to-end task design signal, but its reported agent workflow is not independent wet-lab validation. AUREN has no expert-scored cheminformatics benchmark or experimental replication. The newest chemistry and physical-engineering workflows underscore the need for expert constraints and real-world validation; vendor demonstrations and benchmark scores are not scientific replication. AgenticSciML (Nature, 2026-04-30) describes 10+ specialized agents proposing, critiquing and refining scientific-ML solutions; this is a workflow paper, not independent experimental replication. SymBOL (IEEE TPAMI, 2026-11) combines Bayesian optimization with LLM symbolic regression and reports benchmark improvements in its tested datasets, including materials-science and epidemiology examples. AUREN has no expert-scored symbolic-discovery benchmark or independent domain replication; generated equations and candidate mechanisms remain hypotheses. Nature's 2026-10-12 drug-discovery perspective argues that scientist-in-the-loop co-pilots remain the practical deployment model for open-ended discovery, with human authorization and expert review retained for high-risk experimental and translational decisions. This is a workflow/design signal, not evidence of AUREN scientific performance.
signals.benchmark: Preregister hypotheses, causal graph, analysis and success criteria before outcomes are visible. Use raw versioned datasets, executable baselines, withheld-condition predictions, sensitivity analyses, negative-result retention and independent domain replication. Measure mechanism accuracy, predictive validity, intervention success, novelty, calibration, reproducibility, source-domain regression and resource cost. Add preregistered analysis, withheld-condition prediction, controls, sensitivity checks, expert review and independent replication before learning promotion. Add a preregistered cheminformatics workflow with curated source data, matched-molecular-pair analysis, withheld-compound predictions, negative controls, expert review and wet-lab replication. Preregister claims and analysis; test controls, withheld conditions, structure fidelity, expert rubric, uncertainty, negative results and independent replication. Compare symbolic hypotheses with conventional and expert baselines on frozen datasets, then evaluate on withheld conditions and fresh domains. Measure equation recovery, predictive error, sensitivity, intervention validity, uncertainty, reproducibility, negative-result retention and expert agreement; require independent experimental replication. Include scientist-in-the-loop checkpoints, preregistered objectives and controls, raw-data and instrument provenance, alternative analytical choices, uncertainty, expert scoring, withheld-condition evaluation and independent laboratory replication.
signals.acceptance_threshold: A plausible narrative or literature synthesis is not validation. Promote no lesson without executable evidence, independent replication on fresh tasks, explicit uncertainty, retained negative results and source-domain regression checks. A candidate molecule or synthesis route is not a validated discovery; require independent domain review and experimental replication. Scientific claims and learning promotion remain blocked until independent domain replication succeeds and rollback evidence is retained. Benchmark improvements or plausible equations are not validated scientific discoveries. No scientific lesson or capability claim without executable predictions, controls, withheld-condition success and independent domain replication. No physical experiment, clinical recommendation or scientific capability claim without explicit human authorization for consequential steps, expert review, reproducible raw evidence and independent domain replication.

signals.measured_gap: SentinelBench contains 100 tasks across 10 time-evolving synthetic web environments. It highlights watch/wait/respond tasks where external events, not repeated agent actions, create progress. AUREN has no paired monitoring benchmark for event detection, missed/false wakeups, reaction time, polling churn, resource cost or duplicate effects.
signals.benchmark: Run identical scripted event timelines against bounded polling and event-driven wakeup candidates. Measure task completion, reaction time, missed and false triggers, action count, token/tool cost, deadline behavior, cancellation, duplicate side effects and recovery after process restart. Retain an independent event oracle and exact task/environment digests.
signals.acceptance_threshold: Wakeups must be authenticated and replay-safe; no unbounded polling or retry; occurrence identity and action ledger remain canonical; cancellation/deadline and unknown-outcome reconciliation remain fail-closed. No default trigger promotion without paired measured benefit and independent evaluation.
signals.rollback: Disable the candidate event adapter, preserve occurrence receipts and checkpoints, and return to bounded operator-managed polling or manual invocation through the canonical ExecutionController.
